personal_info.headline: MSc Plant Sciences (Horticulture) & Sustainable Agriculture Researcher
personal_info.bio: Trained in plant physiology through a master's thesis on cryptochrome photoreceptors and seed quality, and co-author of two peer-reviewed publications on seed priming and stress resilience. Experienced in designing and running greenhouse and field experiments, analyzing physiological and optical data, and collaborating across multidisciplinary international research teams through teaching and fieldwork across Japan, India, and the Netherlands.

highlights: Focus on seed physiology, direct sowing enhancements, and environmental stress resilience.
Recipient of the competitive Kambayashi Research Grant and Type 3 Master's Program Scholarship.

thesis.title: Light on Seeds: The Role of Cryptochrome Photoreceptors in Plant Development and Seed Quality Traits in Arabidopsis thaliana
thesis.description: Investigating how cryptochrome blue light photoreceptors modulate germination vigor, seed quality traits, and seedling morphogenesis in Arabidopsis thaliana model systems.

highlights: Conducted thesis research at the world-renowned Laboratory of Plant Physiology at WUR.
Integrated modern physiological assays and spectral light treatments with quantitative phenotyping.
Four-year recipient of Special Exchange Scholarship (full tuition waiver + annual stipend).
Completed thesis work in seed science and tropical horticultural science laboratory.

education.degree: Pre-University / High School (B.Sc. Hons Agriculture Preparatory)
highlights: Awarded University Merit Scholarship for two consecutive academic years.

publications.title: Effect of priming treatment on improving germination and seedling performance of aged and iron-coated rice seeds aiming for direct sowing
publications.authors: Habibi, N., Parneel, Terada, N., Pachakkil, B. et al.
publications.description: Evaluated seed priming protocols on iron-coated aged rice seeds to boost germination rate, uniform seedling emergence, and early vigor tailored for sustainable direct sowing agricultural systems.
publications.citation: Habibi, N., Parneel, Terada, N., Pachakkil, B. et al. (2025). Effect of priming treatment on improving germination and seedling performance of aged and iron-coated rice seeds aiming for direct sowing. Plants, 14, 1683.

publications.title: Novel insights into seed priming for tomato plants: restoring root vitality under salt stress
publications.authors: Habibi, N., Tayobong, R.R.P., Parneel et al.
publications.description: Demonstrated that specific physiological seed priming treatments significantly restore root apical growth, cellular vitality, and seedling vigor in Solanum lycopersicum under acute saline conditions.
publications.citation: Habibi, N., Tayobong, R.R.P., Parneel et al. (2024). Novel insights into seed priming for tomato plants: restoring root vitality under salt stress. Horticulture, Environment and Biotechnology.

publications.title: Artificial Intelligence in Horticulture for Sustainable Agriculture
publications.description: Explored the emerging integration of computer vision, remote sensing, and predictive modeling in greenhouse climate management, phenotyping, and precision resource allocation.
publications.citation: Parneel (2025). Artificial Intelligence in Horticulture for Sustainable Agriculture. Agriculture and Food e-Newsletter, 7(2), 259–261.

research_experience.title: Rooting for the Future: The Lingehof Story
research_experience.description: Investigated diversified cover-crop rotations and regenerative agricultural strategies at Lingehof Organic Farm to enhance soil organic matter, microbial resilience, and drought/excess-rainfall tolerance. Synthesized quantitative ecological data and presented findings in a multidisciplinary symposium poster.

research_experience.title: Teaching Assistant - Laboratory of Tropical Horticultural Science
research_experience.description: Guided undergraduate students through practical experimental sessions in plant physiology and horticultural techniques. Supervised instrument safety, reagent preparation, analytical spectroscopy, and mentored students on data integrity and experimental design.

research_experience.title: Precision Agriculture, Crop Modeling & Remote Sensing
research_experience.description: Completed an intensive two-week international cohort program focusing on precision farming architectures, remote multispectral sensing, crop growth simulation modeling, and digital agricultural transformation with global researchers.

research_experience.title: Subtropical Horticultural Field Training
research_experience.description: Executed hands-on crop production and physiological monitoring on subtropical cultivars including coffee and yams. Conducted mechanized field management, soil moisture monitoring, and practical field harvest data collection under island climatic conditions.

research_experience.title: Chairperson & Delegate - 20th International Student Summit (ISS)
research_experience.description: Elected as Chairperson to represent Tokyo University of Agriculture at the 20th International Student Summit on Food, Agriculture and Environment. Moderated international plenary sessions and synthesized multilateral consensus on youth-driven food security.

other_experience.description: Engaged directly with regional progressive farmers to demonstrate novel agronomic practices, seed varieties, and sustainable crop protection methods.

Worked in a dynamic, high-turnover Tokyo retail environment entirely in Japanese. Developed exceptional cross-cultural interpersonal, inventory management, and multi-tasking skills alongside rigorous academic studies.
Collaborated with international production teams, creative directors, and photographers on commercial promotional campaigns, strengthening poise, communication, and professional adaptability.
